title: fix(app-shell): on a phone, Back with the nav drawer open closes the drawer and stays on the page
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbHny66pXvhYZi1hTZTHzAkc)_
Fixes #29131

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机宽度下，侧边抽屉打开时按返回键（浏览器返回或 Android 返回手势）只关抽屉、留在原页面。抽屉打开时占一条路由历史记录；用其它方式关掉抽屉（点遮罩、Esc、侧栏按钮）会把这条记录退掉；在抽屉里点入口则替换这条记录，所以从新页面返回会回到打开抽屉前的页面。刷新后抽屉保持关闭，不留抽屉记录。桌面宽度不写任何历史。
- **为什么改**：#29075 审计实测，CRM 与 showcase 在 375/390 px 下 4/4 次：打开抽屉再按返回，直接离开列表跳到 /home。手机用户（含 WebView 外壳的 Android 返回）习惯用返回键关菜单。
- **风险与回滚**：低到中。只在 `@object-ui/app-shell` 新增一个 hook，在 `ConsoleLayout` 挂一行；不改 `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 和任何 `components/src/ui/**` 原件。风险点是历史栈：手机上打开抽屉多一条同 URL 的记录，抽屉内链接点击被改为 replace 导航。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/usePhoneNavDrawerHistory.ts` 的三个 effect，尤其抽屉内链接的捕获监听与 popstate 关闭；② `ConsoleLayout.tsx` 的挂载行；③ `urlParams.ts` 新常量 `NAV_DRAWER_OPEN_STATE`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm`，浏览器 375 px 打开 Leads 列表，点 ☰ 打开抽屉，按浏览器返回：抽屉关上，地址仍是 Leads 列表；再按一次返回才离开。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

At phone width (below 768 px) the Console's sidebar is a drawer over the page. Back with the drawer open used to leave the page; now it closes the drawer and the URL stays the page it was on. Implemented as the seat ruled on the card: one router-owned history entry while the drawer is open, no popstate guard.

- **New hook `usePhoneNavDrawerHistory`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/`), mounted once in `ConsoleLayoutInner` beside `useResponsiveSidebar`, inside the sidebar provider. It acts only while `useSidebar().isMobile` is true:
  - Opening the drawer (trigger, edge swipe, shortcut) pushes one entry through the router with the same pathname, search and hash and `NAV_DRAWER_OPEN_STATE: true` in its state.
  - Arriving on an entry without the flag while the drawer is open closes the drawer (Back). A `popstate` listener closes it too: `BrowserRouter` commits the push and a Back pressed before the push committed as one transition, so the router reports no location change at all in that case (found by the live spec, see Tests).
  - Every other close (outside tap, Escape, the trigger) calls `navigate(-1)`, only when the current entry carries the flag.
  - A link chosen inside the drawer replaces the flagged entry: a capture-phase click listener on the document calls `navigate(to, { replace: true })` and prevents the default, so `Link` skips its own push. A link to the page already shown pops the entry instead. This covers the navigation, favorite and recent rows and the drawer's "All apps" link without editing `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` or `@object-ui/layout`.
  - A flagged entry this document did not push (a reload keeps `history.state`) is replaced by one without the flag, and the drawer stays closed. Forward to an entry this document pushed reopens the drawer.
- **`NAV_DRAWER_OPEN_STATE`** sits in `urlParams.ts` beside `RECORD_RELATED_ENLARGE_PUSHED_STATE`. Neither the hook nor the constant is exported from the package entry.
- Desktop is unchanged: with `isMobile` false the hook writes no history.
- No metadata key, no server change, no edit to `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `sidebar.tsx` or any other `components/src/ui/**` primitive. The native shell's Android Back goes through the WebView's history and needs no bridge code.

## Tests

- **Unit** (`usePhoneNavDrawerHistory-29131.test.tsx`, memory router, real `SidebarProvider`, real `UnifiedSidebar` and `NavigationRenderer` links, the sidebar's own route-change close running beside the hook): Back closes the drawer on the same URL; Escape pops the entry and Back goes to the previous page; a nav entry replaces the drawer entry and Back returns to the page the drawer was opened on; the "All apps" link (which closes the drawer itself) does not pop as well; a reload on a flagged entry leaves the drawer closed with the flag gone; Forward reopens the drawer; CONTROL at 1280 px: toggling the sidebar commits no location.
- **Live e2e** (`ui/e2e/live/phone-nav-drawer-back-29131.spec.ts`, Chromium with touch at 375 and 390 px, real history): Back closes the drawer and stays on the list; an outside tap pops the entry and Back goes to the previous page; a nav entry then Back returns to the list; a reload leaves the drawer closed with no flagged entry and the same history length; CONTROL at 1280 px: no history entry. Runs in `test:e2e:live:nightly`, not the `:ci` allowlist (see Acceptance notes).

<details><summary>Reverse checks and ablations</summary>

One-shot, nothing left in the tree (each restore checked: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty).

- E2E with the hook unmounted (the `ConsoleLayout` mount line taken from the base commit, Console rebuilt and served by `vite preview` against a showcase backend): 8 of 8 phone tests red, desktop CONTROL green.
- E2E with only the `popstate` close ablated (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0): exactly the two "Back with the drawer open" tests red (375 and 390), the other 7 green.
- Unit with the hook body ablated (early return): 6 red, desktop CONTROL green.
- Unit with the link capture listener ablated: exactly the two link tests red (nav entry, "All apps"), 5 green.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

**Three deviations from the ruling's text, accepted by the seat:**

1. **A `popstate` close.** The ruling's location-driven close misses a Back pressed before the push commits, because `BrowserRouter` then reports no location change. Measured red in the live spec; the ablation above reds exactly that pair.
2. **Forward to a drawer entry this document pushed reopens the drawer.** Otherwise reopening after a Forward would push a second flagged entry, and Back would stop on a no-op.
3. **A drawer link to the page already shown pops the drawer entry** instead of replacing it, for the same no-op reason.

- **The race the live spec found.** The first live run was red on "Back with the drawer open" at both widths while a manual run passed: the spec pressed Back right after the push. `BrowserRouter` commits locations inside `startTransition`, so the push and the pop collapsed into one commit with an unchanged location and the drawer stayed open. The `popstate` close fixes it; the ablation above shows it is the load-bearing part.
- **Mounted in `ConsoleLayout.tsx`, not `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`**, so this PR does not touch the file #29141 edits.
- **A nav entry of kind `action` that navigates in code** pushes as before (only links are intercepted). Back from that page returns to the drawer entry, and the drawer reopens there (the Forward rule), then the next Back closes it.
- **After a reload with the drawer open** the flagged entry is replaced in place, as ruled, so the history keeps two entries with the same URL; one Back after such a reload stays on the page.
- **The live spec runs in `test:e2e:live:nightly`** (claim amendment 6576569654 added that one `ui/package.json` script line). It stays out of `:ci` for that job's two-minute budget; promotion is a later call once nightly has a run population for it.
- NOT MEASURED: Android Back inside the native shell, reason: no native shell in this container. It goes through the same WebView history the browser's Back exercises.

## Verification

Step 07 of the card on the real Console: production build served at `/_console` by `objectstack dev --fresh` (`examples/app-crm` on its lead list, `examples/app-showcase` on its task list), Chromium with `isMobile` and touch, DPR 2. "Before" is the Console built without the mount line (equivalent to `main` 07eaec2d); "after" is the final hook. Script and every screenshot: project files `issue-29131/` (`step07.cjs`, `before/`, `after/`).

| 07c a nav entry, then Back returns to the list, drawer closed | pass → pass | pass → pass | pass → pass | pass → pass |
| 07d reload with the drawer open: closed, no flagged entry, same history length | pass → pass | pass → pass | pass → pass | pass → pass |

Before, 07a: `{"urlBefore":".../_console/apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead","urlAfter":".../_console/home","drawerStill":false}`, the card's reading, in all four runs. After: `urlAfter` equals `urlBefore`, `drawerStill` false, flag false.
